origin: DERIVED: FIX8 registered viewer silhouettes, not a MODEL or geometry tolerance
rule: Minimum fraction = min(tested_pixels / projected_pixels) across the six registered FIX8 views = 1. Each current view must test at least that fraction of both its complete projected silhouette and the registered silhouette at this viewport. Empty, unresolved or depth-clipped projections refuse. A changed viewport needs a new explicit registration.
